teaching_clarity.rationale: The single-generator case gives moral uncertainty a persistent object. The scalar shortcut, value-conflict record, lease, rights receipt, standing repair, finite harness, and objective-formation handoff are distinct and remain explicitly bounded.

composition.rationale: The generator, two destinations, record fields, lease, receipt, custodian, dissent, and open evidence lanes maintain a stable desk grid. The 30 beat samples and caption review sheet keep labels readable without generic card-grid filler.

motion_quality.rationale: Each beat changes a relation, custody boundary, authority state, record field, repair, or evidence boundary. Intentional reading holds are paired with narrated reasoning and visible state, rather than being silent dead air.

synchronization.rationale: Thirty receipt-derived beat boundaries, 401.895 seconds of audio, 90 exact receipt-derived caption cues, and the muxed master agree. The plan audit reports complete story coverage and the AV audit reports matching duration and no black or silent intervals.

continuity.rationale: The generator token, clinic, homes, value-conflict record, lease, rights receipt, dissent payload, and review clock recur across the allocation puzzle and worked trace, then carry into the governed-objective handoff.

pacing.rationale: The 913-word narration runs at 136.3 words per minute. Its 401.895-second runtime is above the preferred three-to-six-minute range by design: removing the standing repair, rights/export/fork duties, finite boundary, or handoff would collapse load-bearing responsibilities; the six-minute value is a soft target.

voice.rationale: The narration distinguishes a temporary decision from moral truth, consensus, legal right, institutional adequacy, and safe deployment. It treats dissent and uncertainty as carried state rather than a defect to be hidden.

sound_mix.rationale: The muxed animatic is 48 kilohertz mono AAC and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.1 LU range, and minus 1.3 dBTP. Mechanical diagnostics report no clipping or silence.

engagement.rationale: The emergency allocation hook, tempting scalar, missing-standing stop, repaired lease, rights receipt, replacement reopening, and unresolved final callback create a humane reveal without manufacturing a moral verdict.

accessibility.rationale: Position, enclosure, arrows, line style, and labels duplicate color. All 90 captions pass exact timing and representative-frame review, and the adjacent descriptive transcript covers every material transition.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The visual remains a design-rationale derivative of a synthetic civic case. It does not promote the record schemas, finite harness, or worked trace into proof of moral truth, rights, fair deployment, institutional adequacy, or any empirical, safety, AGI, or ASI result.

non_claim: Passing animatic records a chapter-specific audiovisual teaching candidate only; picture-and-sound lock, release-candidate, independent review, publication, and book-evidence promotion remain ungranted. Rejected and superseded renders remain preserved in ignored build generation history.
